headline: Rogers State's goals come from seven different players
dek: Rogers State have won all three of their matches, and seven different players have shared their goals; only Harkaran Sahota and Alex Laing have scored twice. Ouachita Baptist remain the other unbeaten side and have yet to concede.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Rogers State alone have outscored Newman, Southern Nazarene, Northeastern State and Harding put together.

wire.line: Harding's first goal of the season means every programme in the conference has now scored.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ouachita Baptist's match at Southwest Baptist is past its date with no result published at all, the only match this season in that state. There is no score gap: every match marked final carries a score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Every match with a published score also has a box score behind it. The collector reached the detail of each.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Harding's defeat by Christian Brothers has tipped the conference's record against outside opponents to ten defeats against nine wins. Ouachita Baptist's draw with Delta State is still the only match this season that a programme in this conference has neither won nor lost.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Harding have lost all three of their matches, every one of them at home, scoring once and conceding five. Reik Barrack is their only scorer.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Andrew Wagenblatt has made fifteen saves for Harding and been beaten five times.

last_match.line: Reik Barrack's goal was Harding's first of the season, but they have still lost every match they have played, all of them at home.

next_match.line: Ouachita Baptist have yet to concede; Dallas Baptist arrive having already won at Harding.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
